assertions: D4 layout, ordered accumulation, and view-zero feature retention are exact for rectangular batch layouts.
The locked checkpoint preserves logits, peak coordinates, detections, IDs, and pair contexts for CPU serial versus eight-view batching.

prior_target_gpu_evidence.scope: one exact V45 two-frame 64x64x64 input, serial versus four-view batch

decision.reason: The existing target-hardware A/B already establishes that batching V45 views is numerically safe but materially increases memory for an immaterial speed gain. Eight-view batching would increase peak batch pressure without a new evidence-based speed hypothesis.
decision.retain: Eager sequential eight-view V45 remains the detector quality reference.
decision.next_direction: Train and validate a one-pass checkpoint-derived detector/embedding head before considering a lower-inference-cost production route.
